sources: import { catalog } from "@workspace/domain"; export const key = (name, input) => [name, input];

const bound = { read: async (input, actor) => operation.publicResult.parse(await binding.execute(input, actor)) }; function assertReversal(command, catalog, result) { if (result.reversal && (!result.reversal.expect || !Object.keys(result.reversal.expect.matches).length) && (catalog || !REVERSAL_EXPECT_PENDING.commands.some((name) => name === command))) throw new Error("Reversals require a guarded expectation"); }
class Registry { async execute() { const ran = await command.run(parsed, actor); assertReversal(command.name, this.isCatalogOperation(command.name), ran); return ran; } }

export const run = (client, name, input) => client.command(name, input); export const key = (client, name, input) => client.key(name, input); export const adopted = (client) => client.command("job.setPriority", { priority: "high" });
